notes: Fixes the dashboard being all dashes. v0.20.0 only listened for pushed values, and this deck's CAN service volunteers almost nothing - the first real photo showed battery voltage and headlights arriving and every other tile stuck on a dash. But the same readings sit behind 64 getters that nothing was calling. DWM now polls them once a second on a background thread as well as listening for pushes, whichever arrives first wins, and it re-sends the vendor's own requestData refresh every five seconds instead of only once at connect. It treats -1 as absent, which is what the vendor documents it to mean, so a tile stays blank rather than reading minus one. The scan report gains a WHERE EACH SIGNAL CAME FROM list: every signal that produced a real value and whether it was pushed or polled. Anything missing from that list returned -1 from its getter and was never pushed, which means this car genuinely does not put it on the bus - that list is what decides which tiles are worth keeping. If the dashboard is still mostly blank after this, run a scan with the engine RUNNING and send section 0b.
